scope: Resolve all original unclassified required process apparatus with explicit M class planning choices. new_categories.association_basis: User-authorized required process-slot extension. Atmospheric-pressure natural/forced-convection laboratory ovens for drying, ageing and thermal curing. Excludes M18 vacuum ovens, tube furnaces and hydrothermal reactors. Actual solvent ventilation, atmosphere and material compatibility must be checked. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Laboratory uniaxial mechanical/hydraulic compression presses, with unheated or heated platens/dies for compaction, pellet making, lamination and hot compression. Excludes nanoimprint lithography M60 and SPS category M69. Heated operation is model/configuration dependent. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. General laboratory nonplanetary grinding and mortar systems for dry/wet size reduction, powder mixing and sample preparation. Record mechanism explicitly: pressure/friction mortar grinders differ from cutting/impact batch mills. Excludes high-energy planetary mills in M12; category membership does not establish nano-size output. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. In-line diffusion or membrane dryer that removes solvent vapor from an aerosol without intentionally collecting its particles. Distinct from spray dryers and compressed-air dryers. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Aerosol neutralizer or charger that establishes a controlled particle-charge distribution before electrical-mobility classification. Bipolar and unipolar instruments require the matching measurement model. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Condensation particle counter or aerosol electrometer used to detect/count particles or measure particle-borne charge after classification. Electrometers require a known charge state to infer particle count. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Impaction or electrostatic collection apparatus that captures aerosol particles onto substrates for recovery or offline analysis; selecting a collector requires the relevant size range, flow and collection substrate. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Complete systems that produce, select, accelerate and deliver an ion beam into a solid substrate for implantation or material modification. Excludes generic plasma etchers, ion-milling-only tools and ion-source components. Selection of catalyst species, dose, substrate and end station requires model-specific review. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Integrated metal melting/alloying and casting systems with suitable mould/crucible hardware, atmosphere control and casting arrangement; includes vacuum/inert induction and arc-melting systems with casting options. Distinct from annealing-only induction heaters. Alloy chemistry, reactivity, casting dimensions and optional hardware must be checked. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Purpose-built presses that force a metal billet through a die to make elongated rods, wire, tubes or profiles. Excludes CNC machining, rolling mills, polymer-only screw extruders and generic presses without documented metal extrusion capability. Alloy, die, billet heater, extrusion ratio and force must be checked. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.

User-authorized required process-slot extension. Reaction chambers/flow cells and their optical coupling for nanoparticle laser ablation in liquids. Laser source remains M56. Laboratory custom builds require configuration-specific engineering; analytical LA-ICP-MS cells are not assumed suitable. Market membership is functional classification; exact process/configuration suitability requires review.
